decisions.name: Retry limit
decisions.question: Where should the retry limit live?
decisions.why: Three call sites hard-code 3 today. The upload path needs 5, so the value has to move somewhere before that lands.

options.label: Shared constant in config.ts
options.detail: One place to change, no API change.

options.label: Per-call option with a default of 3
options.detail: Flexible, but every caller grows a parameter.

options.label: Leave as is, hard-code 5 in the upload path
options.detail: Smallest diff, a fourth copy of the number.

decisions.pick: only one caller needs a different value, so an option on every call is more surface than the problem.

decisions.name: Error copy
decisions.question: What should the user see when all retries fail?
decisions.why: Today the upload path shows a raw status code. The notice component already has a generic failure message.

options.label: Write a new message for uploads
options.detail: Most specific, one more string to translate.

options.label: Reuse the existing notice
options.detail: No new strings, slightly generic wording.

decisions.pick: close call, but upload failures are common enough to deserve their own wording.

decisions.name: Feature flag
decisions.question: Should the new retry behavior ship behind a flag?
decisions.why: The change touches every network call. A flag costs one extra cleanup PR later.

options.label: Ship behind the flag
options.detail: Can be turned off without a deploy.

options.label: Ship it on for everyone
options.detail: Less code, a revert is the only way back.

decisions.pick: the blast radius is every request, so a kill switch is cheap insurance.

decisions.name: Test coverage
decisions.question: How far should the tests go?
decisions.why: The retry helper has unit tests. Nothing exercises it against a real failing server.

options.label: Add one end to end test with a failing endpoint
options.detail: Catches wiring mistakes, adds about a minute to CI.

options.label: Full matrix across every call site

decisions.pick: one real failure path covers the wiring without the cost of the matrix.

decisions.name: PR split
decisions.question: One pull request or two?
decisions.why: The config move is mechanical and touches 14 files. The upload change is 40 lines and needs careful review.

options.label: One PR
options.detail: Lands together, the careful part hides in the noise.

options.label: Two PRs, config move first
options.detail: Easier review, one extra round trip.

decisions.pick: the reviewer can skim the first and read the second properly.
